prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all tested kinds of change ('adoption, new_flow', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder') as each has only 1 test.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, new_flow', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, redesign' changes.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] story_carousel_layout_switch: Switch the introductory story screen to a interactive carousel layout with visual cards. (why: Choose path screen has a mean duration of 514s and a 23.8% dropoff, indicating users get stuck or bored on text-heavy story introductions.)
1: [sign_in, copy] sign_in_data_preservation_headline: Update the sign-in headline and hint to explicitly emphasize account sync and pet state protection. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] pet_personality_quiz_flow: Add a 2-question personality screening screen before pet selection to match users with their ideal pet type. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in onboarding at 60.9% and a median time of 89s.)
3: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_progress_tips: Display setup progress indicators and rotating tip cards while pet asset generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting/home screen has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user uncertainty about setup progress.)
4: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_quality_tip: Add clear helper tips and format details directly on the photo upload screen. (why: Support received 3 bug reports stating that custom pet generation fails or looks wrong.)
5: [finish, new_screen] onboarding_completion_summary_screen: Introduce a completion summary screen with clear action buttons after home_intro. (why: Finish stage mean time is 5815s with significant dropoff, indicating users lack clarity when onboarding is complete.)
6: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_troubleshooting_notification: Add a visible sign-in retry button and error delay hint on the sign-in screen. (why: Support received bug reports that the sign-in screen stalls or fails to appear properly.)

scores.note: Choose_path has 23.8% dropoff and high mean duration, but no support emails exist and redesigns haven't performed well.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in dropoff; easy copy change.
Adoption has highest dropoff (39.1%), but adding screens is high cost and prior adoption new_flow only gained +0.6%.
Addresses high median wait time on home screen indicated by funnel data.
Targets highest dropoff stage with 3 support reports; low effort hint addition.
Finish screen has high dropoff, but adding a new screen to finish stage previously yielded -6.5%.
Supported by bug reports regarding sign-in stalling; moderate UI change.
